note: Slice 4's rig sockets and slice 8's game sockets (rig_hobie16.sockets, sockets_hobie16.py): Unreal's frame, X forward, Y to starboard, Z up, cm, the body frame; each one's part in 'owner', the build object it sits on in 'near' (sockets_check_hobie16.py), where it comes from in 'from'.

from.MastStep: the mast's heel on the step's ball (rig_hobie16: the mast part's origin, about which it rotates)
from.ForestayTack: the bridle plate on the forestay's line, where the forestay and both bridle wires meet (rig_hobie16)
from.ChainplateUpper_P: the shroud's pin in its chainplate at the hull's deck edge (rig_hobie16.chainplate); she has no lowers and no spreaders, so there is no ChainplateLower or SpreaderTip (the game then draws one shroud a side)
from.ChainplateUpper_S: the shroud's pin in its chainplate at the hull's deck edge (rig_hobie16.chainplate); she has no lowers and no spreaders, so there is no ChainplateLower or SpreaderTip (the game then draws one shroud a side)
from.RudderPivot: the port rudder's pintles' axis at the design waterline (rudder_hobie16.layout: the part's origin, about which the game turns it; the first is the port one, as on the fleet's model)
from.RudderPivot_1: the starboard rudder's pintles' axis at the design waterline (rudder_hobie16.layout: the part's origin, about which the game turns it; the first is the port one, as on the fleet's model)
from.JibLead_P: the jib car's ratchet block's sheave on the front crossbar's track, where the sheet comes down from the clew (hardware_hobie16: the 2:1's lower sheave)
from.JibWinch_P: the fairlead of the cam over that block, where the tail leaves for the crew's hand: no winch, as the J/22's JibWinch is its cam's fairlead (the game wraps no drum on a boat without sheet winches)
from.JibLead_S: the jib car's ratchet block's sheave on the front crossbar's track, where the sheet comes down from the clew (hardware_hobie16: the 2:1's lower sheave)
from.JibWinch_S: the fairlead of the cam over that block, where the tail leaves for the crew's hand: no winch, as the J/22's JibWinch is its cam's fairlead (the game wraps no drum on a boat without sheet winches)
from.LazySheetVia: where the lazy sheet bears on the mast's aft face on its way from the clew to the other car (hardware_hobie16: lazy_on_mast_above_heel_m over the heel); the game slides it aft to the clew's station when the clew is aft of it, as hers is
from.Traveler_C: the top of the eye on the traveller car's swivel post, the car centred: the mainsheet's lower block hangs from it (hardware_hobie16)
from.Traveler_S: the same eye with the car run out to starboard against its stop on the rear crossbar (stop_y_m less the stop's and the car's half widths): the end of the car's travel
from.Gooseneck: the boom's pivot at the main's tack (sails_hobie16: the boom part's origin). The game hangs the boom on the physics' gooseneck (MainLuffX, BoomZ); slice 10's test holds the two together
from.FootBrace_P: the middle of the hiking strap on that side, on its top: where a crew member sitting out hooks a foot (the game's crew read FootBrace_S/P where a model has it; not required, since the fleet's has none)
from.FootBrace_S: the middle of the hiking strap on that side, on its top: where a crew member sitting out hooks a foot (the game's crew read FootBrace_S/P where a model has it; not required, since the fleet's has none)
from.Hounds: the hounds on the mast's axis inside its cast band (rig_hobie16), the point slice 4 solved the wires' pin-to-pin lengths to: the game draws the forestay, both shrouds and the trapeze wires to it, so their last few centimetres run inside the mast, past the built tangs, where they don't show
from.Masthead: the mast's top on its axis (the check's mast length)
from.MastheadAft: the masthead's aft face: she has no backstay, so the game draws nothing from it, but the fleet's set has it
from.MastBase: the mast's heel (the check's mast length; no vang reads it: she has none)
from.Boom_Mainsheet: the mainsheet's upper block's sheaves under the boom (hardware_hobie16: hung from its bail), where the game's mainsheet starts
from.Boom_Clew: the main's clew at the boom's end (sails_hobie16)
from.RudderStock: the rudder head's top on its pivot line (rudder_hobie16.layout)
from.RudderBolt: the kick-up pin through the castings, about which the blade swings up (rudder_hobie16)

not_written.TillerEnd: the game holds a tiller extension from the rudder's TillerEnd; hers hangs from the middle of the tiller crossbar, which joins both rudders and is built on the hull (H16Tiller_Crossbar, with the extension laid along it), as the fleet's model does: slice 10 decides how the game draws it
